source_receipts.receipt_summary: OpenReview search was reachable as a dynamic discovery page; secondary search listings were not promoted without newer primary forum-page evidence.
The direct OpenReview notes API required challenge verification, so this route is recorded as an endpoint failure rather than a fabricated negative result.
Hugging Face Papers listed daily paper ids, including V524/V525 duplicates such as AREX; this secondary feed did not provide a newer primary-source Carnot hook.
Semantic Scholar EBT citation trail returned 20 records. The newest citation was Memoir 2607.20792 from 2026-07-22, already accepted in the sealed V525 planner block.
Semantic Scholar ARM-EBM citation trail returned eight records; the newest dated citation was 2026-07-02 and one record had null publicationDate, so no post-marker actionable source is promoted.
GitHub search was dependency metadata only; no maintained post-marker repository displaced Carnot's exact local backends.
GitHub issue discovery surfaced unrelated transactional message metadata rather than a Carnot-relevant memory-poisoning method.
